title: West Metropolis Archipelago
safeHtml:
'''West Metropolis Archipelago''' (Abbreviated as '''WMA''') is the coined term for a total of 147 Islands that lay on the sea between Los Sengas Continent, Peckern Continent and Twenty-Second Continent. It is named after the fact that the islands lay to the west of Los Sengas Downtown. The representative color of the WMA in Los Sengas is Light Blue, and the District Number is 5.

Description

The WMA mainly consists of a vast ocean, with islands being scattered across the sea. Multiple lines of Nazca Railway cross the WMA using underwater tunnels, but this area is also mainly served by the Nazca Ferry. Moreover, multiple routes and trunk roads pass under the ocean between the islands. Therefore, despite being mainly consisted of the sea, this area could still be seen as an important transport node in Los Sengas. The Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development also ensured that players who are qualified regardless of status could also develop their own islands. As a result, this area is one of the most actively developed areas in Los Sengas.

List of Islands and Sub-Districts

It should be noted that while Centopia to the southwest is also an island, it belongs to a separate district and does not belong to the WMA.

is the first line in NR Los Sengas Division to commence services and complete. It is a circular line that serves west Los Sengas. With 37 stations along the route, has the third highest number of stations among all the Los Sengas Division railway lines (behind and ). The first section of this route between and commenced services on March 16 2015, with the whole line completing works on September 29 2015, with a station (Metro Stone Station) being added along the line on August 27 2016.

Description

is the first line in NR to be established. It travels through Downtown, Sava, The Western Metropolis Archipelago (WMA), Peckern, Airship Island, Twenty-Second Continent and TriPaw Peninsula, before going back to Metropolis Terminal through the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

This line is represented by Red on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 1.

Currently, this route is 57.895 km long, with a total of 37 stations (Among the 37 stations, 20 are interchanges).

Route Establishment (Birth of )

appeared with Metropolis Terminal on March 15 2015, and is the first route in Los Sengas. This line entered services alongside Greenrock Hill Station on March 16. The first section of development sees connecting Downtown with Sava. Subsequent Development of the line saw it extending to the WMA on April 6 with the commencement of services for Bufly Island Station, where it interchanges with .

Crossing the Seas ( extension to Peckern Mainland)

One month later, on May 11, NR once again extends , and the northern terminus of the lines was changed to Caver Island Station, also located in the WMA, before reaching the new southern terminus of South Bay Station alongside on May 30, which is located at the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

Reunion at another Continent (Convergence of and )

Later, NR made an extension to the west of the WMA for by mid-June, and works were carried out for it to converge with . On July 7, reached Gull Woods Station on Peckern Continent, and by July 15, it extended to Peckern Forest Station alongside .

After the two lines converged, NR built a six-station triangular interchange system for the , and a new line named . Among the six stations involved, passed through Wativer Station and Treeless Hill Station, both of which involved interchanging with .

Progress more than half (Progressing to Ring Completion)

reaching Treeless Hill Station signified that works are now more than 50% complete. As a result, NR temporarily suspended further works for this line on S1E11 in order to construct Rover Down Checkpoint. Then, after half a month of zero progress, to facilitate development of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, extended southwards from South Bay Station to Numpool Station and Miner North Station, before further extending the terminus on the Peckern Side to Wood Wound Station.

Subsequently, extended from the Tripaw Peninsula to Sheung Che Nung Station of the Twenty-Second Continent in S1E14. By then, the only section left unconstructed was the one between Sheung Che Nung Station and Wood Wound Station.

Ring Completion

In S1E15, extended into Airship Island territory and entered Twenty-Second Continent. In the process of connecting to Sheung Che Nung Station, also passed through Comp Ward Station and Comic Ward Station, which reserved room for interchanges with , and respectively.

With the opening of Tai Nung Plains Station on September 29 2015, has finally formed a complete loop, and hence became the first line to complete development.

Subsequent Development

On August 27 2016, Metro Stone Station was added between Metropolis Terminal and Greenrock Hill Station for the Inner Ring Direction, where the Metro Stone Railway Building was constructed. On May 17 2020, the Outer Ring Direction also stops at this station.

'''Whitecliff Village Stabling Sidings''' is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for . It is located to the south of Whitecliff Village Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Miner Bay Depot, Vector Bay Depot and Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to 16 nine-carriage trains.

Description

Sidings

The two sides have eight sidings each, which can store 16 trains.

Connecting Tracks

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to , with access to Daisy Island Station <!--Checkpoint--> to the west and Sunflower Garden Station to the east.

Other Facts

Besides of increasing the capacity for , this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing dispatch frequencies in mind. This Stabling Siding is located on ground level, and high walls are set up around this stabling siding to prevent breaches into this Stabling Siding and causing potential danger. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Vector Bay Depot.

'''Whitemart''' is a Supercenter that is constructed and operated by PTT. Railway. It is located at Los Sengas Leben Island within the Nazca Railway Headquarters.

Floor Distribution

  • First Floor (1/F, Y=79)
  • Shopping Area
  • Ground Floor (G/F, Y=71)
  • Parking Lot
  • Online Pick-Up Area
  • Loading and Unloading Area

  • Whitemart Pharmacy
  • Los Sengas Coffee

Description

Location and Exterior

Whitemart is located at the northeasterly side of Leben Island to the south side of Yigeoi Street directly opposite to the East Outdoor Grocery Mall. It is two storeys high and features three separate sets of entrances, with one set at the west, one set at the north and one set at the east.

First Floor

The First Floor of this Supermart features a shopping area that features a total of 26 racks of goods and 30 isles. Each Rack contains 20 columns of goods, and each isle at the center and the edges provide access to 10 columns and 20 columns respectively. It is also connected to the ground floor by elevator and escalators.

Ground Floor

The Ground Floor of this Supermart houses the entrances and parking lot of this Supercenter, as well as another Shopping Area, the Whitemart Pharmacy and the Los Sengas Coffee.

The west entrance is entry only, whereas the north entrance and east entrance are for visitors with vehicles that are visiting the store and performing Online Pick-Up respectively. However, the east entrance can also be used for visitors who want to visit the superstore, albeit with lower capacity.

The Parking lot for this Supercenter is located to the northeast of the building structure of Whitemart. In total, it features 45 normal parking spaces, four parking spaces for Online Pick-up Users and a Pick-Up and Drop-Off Area that is marked with blue lines. It also provides access to the Loading and Unloading Area of the Whitemart.

The Online Pick-Up Area is located at the east side of the building. It features three different counters and is designed in an orange motif, unlike the rest of Whitemart which has a white color scheme. It also provides staff access to the Loading and Unloading Area located to the east of the Building.

Whitemart Pharmacy is located directly to the south of the Online Pick-Up area. It provides four different counters and a rack for medicine. It is also directly connected to the Loading and Unloading Area, and sells Golden Apples, Enchanted Golden Apples, Potions of Strength, Dragon's Breath, Potions of Instant Health and Potions of Protection.

The shopping area is located at the center area of this building. Besides of six smaller racks in the same style as the ones on the First Floor, larger racks with 16 columns, 18 columns and 24 columns are also seen, which in turn surrounds the eleavtor and escalator access to the First Floor, as well as booths that displays Pastries and Fresh Produce. The north end of this building features the Check-Out Area with 8 self-serving counters and 6 staffed check-out Counters.

The Los Sengas Coffee is located at the Southeast Corner of this building and serves the same goods as Los Sengas Coffess in Nazca Railway stations.

Fun Facts

  • This Supercenter is built in the style of Walmart.
  • The name of this Supercenter pays tribute to White Market Station of the now-defunct Heaven Pacific Division of Nazca Railway.
  • Although Whitemart is a supercenter specifically designed for Leben Island, this supercenter is now also seen in Jupiter, with two other supercenters set at Tat Stone Hill and Stamford.
